en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two‑story half‑timbered and plaster townhouses covered with climbing vines. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the street. In the far background a church tower rises above the roofs. The caption in red German script appears at the bottom left, with publishing information in smaller red type at the bottom.
